Anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi ke bich mulakaton ka silsila jari hai. isi dauran manish kashyap anant sinh ke hone vale damad rishikesh kumar se mile. donon ne ek-dusre se mulakat ki aur shadi ko lekar badhaee evan shubhkamnaen din. dekhie is mulakat ki khas tasviren.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
